seed_selection.clock_policy: 真实时钟；不改观测或导入时间凑可比；TTL/eligible不匹配阻塞或记不可比；cache/elapsed差异明记

stop_conditions: missing exact per-run authorization, code/model/environment/renderer binding or funding preflight
insufficient money to finish complete authorized batch
no eligible seed for hint pair
execution_plan.change_policy: 版本/条件/材料变化保留旧attempt，受影响冻结另确认并另授权新完整批次；不得替换失败、补成功或自动增加次数。
execution_plan.optimization: 至少1真实症状经诊断、最小修改、离线回归、独立审查、另授权真实复测纠正；调试材料与独立验收材料分开。

per_round_input_isolation.controller_only: full script and future round messages
per_round_input_isolation.model_input: current round message + previously committed actual history + currently accepted conditions + authorized current evidence
per_round_input_isolation.input_ref_meaning: controller script locator, never whole script injection
per_round_input_isolation.implementation_check: capture full compiled input for every round; assert current expected message present and future messages/unaccepted condition fields absent; persist revision/history provenance
per_round_input_isolation.status: runtime enforcement pending implementation; required before real evaluation

prerequisites.first_engineering_task: DEC-T07-01 separate code and exact isolated PostgreSQL scope authorization; no funding required for fake engineering tests
prerequisites.real_pilot: T09 runnable path, real accounts, F1, complete history/unknown/inflight reconciliation, complete batch coverage, <=24h pricing snapshot and exact grants
prerequisites.M1_independent: before each batch, satisfy actual review and the applicable bindings due at that batch with blocks_real_execution=true; fixed slots and material/scorer separation apply throughout; actual E2E-derived seed is due before source hints, and human source review/acceptance/practice records are due at their stated scoring or M1 acceptance gates
prerequisites.runtime_binding_gate_policy: Evaluate each binding by its before time and applicability to the current operation. Only applicable, currently due bindings with blocks_real_execution=true block dispatch; later-batch bindings do not block an earlier prerequisite batch. Missing first-run funding/code/account/authorization evidence always blocks the first paid run. The E2E-derived seed cannot be required before E2E; blocks_real_execution=false human acceptance/practice evidence remains mandatory for M1 acceptance, never prefilled or waived.
prerequisites.formal_Go: unchanged formal15 attempts plus full five accounts/admin, capacity, safe recovery, encrypted offline backup restore; r12/P02/product No-Go
prerequisites.source_drift: AI before run re-observes URLs and fixed identity, records changes; human confirms material or condition changes affecting scoring before exact run grant
